product: No.5+ Glutathione Vitamin Concentrated Toner Pads

reviews.headline: Love the Glow
reviews.comment:
These pads are AMAZING! 😍 I absolutely love the ridges on the pads because they help gently exfoliate and smooth out the look of my skin texture.

I also love the healthy glow they give my skin! My skin looks smoother, fresher, and more radiant after using them. ✨ Definitely one of those skincare products that makes you feel like your skin is glowing from within!
